Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning employee benefits purchased by the public employees' benefits board.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to employee benefits purchased by the publicemployees' benefits board; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to adopt legislationregarding employee benefits purchased by the public employees' benefitsboard in order to implement the 200911 operating budget.
